red_cross_clothes_2026.publisher: Red Cross of the City of Skopje
red_cross_clothes_2026.scope: 20 April 2026 list: eight containers at six venues plus Kopche and Momin Potok warehouse. Clean, washed, usable clothes for donation/reuse. Five venues mapped; three held pending coordinate/address resolution. Venue coordinates are not individual bin positions; operating status is not live.

kopche_clothes.publisher: Red Cross of the City of Skopje
kopche_clothes.scope: Kopche donation/reuse shop at Kocho Racin 13. Route one venue, not separate headquarters/shop/container duplicates. Newer April 2026 announcement is used for published donation hours where this older page differs.

pakomak_streams.scope: Packaging streams: green glass; yellow plastic/cans/metal; blue paper/Tetra Pak.

pakomak_faq.scope: Citizens Q18: Tetra Pak in blue; Q20: plastic bags in yellow; Q25: empty plastic/glass packaging; Q26: bulk caps require contact.

pakomak_vending.scope: Reverse vending collects plastic bottles and cans; PET is named. Do not extend this to bags, cartons or chemical containers.

nula_categories.scope: Electrical/electronic equipment and waste batteries. This is not evidence that each collection point accepts every subtype or condition.

nula_pickup.scope: Electronic-waste collection requests via 070236000. Pickup service, not a verified walk-in facility.

karpos_household.scope: Ordinary household waste goes in municipal containers. App subset: used personal tissues and household nappies. Item-level mapping is an agent inference, not explicit municipal item-by-item approval. Excludes clinical, chemical, electronic and bulky waste.

east_gate_ewaste.scope: 18 December 2024 announcement: East Gate Mall collection of small electrical/electronic equipment, including used lamps. App subset: phones, chargers, cables and earbuds only; no large appliances, loose batteries or lamps. Container position and current operation not independently confirmed.

karpos_ewaste.scope: Karpos waste selection centre accepts household electrical/electronic appliances, free drop-off, daily 07:00–19:00. Confirm present operation; excludes batteries and hazardous conditions from this app's routing subset.

source_names: Red Cross of the City of Skopje
profiles.limits: Donate clean, washed, wearable clothes, bagged for collection. No torn, wet, stained or contaminated textiles. Donation/reuse, not evidence of general textile recycling. Pins identify venues, not individual containers. Check access/opening arrangements with the venue.
No inference for drinking glasses, ceramics, mirrors, or hazardous contents.
Preserve narrow snapshot capabilities. General yellow-bin policy alone does not prove this specific site accepts bags or trays.
Tetra Pak expansion is scoped to this operator/container profile, not all paper sites. Contaminated/coated ambiguous items require clarification.
Conservative app subset. Require suitable shape/label and machine acceptance; exclude shampoo bottles, bags, food tins, chemicals and crushed items until specifically confirmed.
Ordinary household used tissues/nappies only. Recorded bin locations, not field-verified acceptance. No clinical, hazardous, electronic or bulky waste.

Household electrical/electronic devices; daily 07:00–19:00 as published. Ask staff where to unload. No loose batteries, lamps, leaking/swollen batteries or chemically contaminated equipment. Check with the operator before travel.

Small devices only: phones, chargers, cables and earbuds. No large appliances, loose batteries or damaged batteries. Operator announcement dated December 2024; confirm availability with Elkolekt on +38971263500. Pin is the mall entrance, not the collection container.

wearable_clothes.message: Donate clean, washed, wearable clothes for reuse; damaged textiles need different guidance.

small_electronics.message: Small electrical devices need separate collection. Use a documented drop-off point or request home pickup from Nula Otpad.

electronics.message: Electrical items need separate collection. Use the Karpos drop-off centre or contact Nula Otpad for pickup.

batteries.message: Confirm the battery type and condition with the operator. Damaged, swollen or leaking batteries need specific guidance; ordinary battery collection acceptance is not sufficient.

other_specialist.message: No locally verified acceptance evidence yet for this waste type. Do not route to a general-waste site.

clothes-karpos-red-cross: Red Cross entrance, Orce Nikolov 155v — look for the clothes donation containers.
clothes-dare-dzambaz: 11 Oktomvri 42a — clothes containers are in front of Dare Dzambaz Humanitarian House.
clothes-kopche: Kocho Racin 13 — ask for Kopche. Published donation hours: weekdays 08:00–17:00, Saturday 09:00–14:00; check before travel.
clothes-kisela-voda: Municipal grounds, Petar Deljan 17 — look for the Red Cross clothes container in front of the office.
clothes-city-hall: City Hall grounds, Ilinden 82 — ask reception for the Red Cross clothes container. Access follows the venue's opening arrangements.
ewaste-east-gate-mall: Mall entrance — ask the information desk for the small-electronics collection point.
